test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 15 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Consider the given statement and decide which of the given assumptions is/are implicit in the statement.

**Statement:**

RTE has mandated compulsory enrolment of all children of the age 6 to 14 years in the schools.

**Assumptions:**

I: Enrollment needs to be made compulsory as children don't like education.

II. Each child of the country will get quality Education.

options.text: Either assumption I or assumption II is implicit.
Neither assumption I nor assumption II is implicit.

solution:
Given Statement: RTE has mandated compulsory enrolment of all children of the age 6 to 14 years in the schools.

Now, 

Assumptions:

1. Enrollment needs to be made compulsory as children don't like education - Not Implicit (The statement does not provide any information regarding children's attitude towards education)

2. Each child of the country will get quality Education - Not Implicit (The statement mandates enrollment, but does not guarantee the quality of education)

Here, Neither assumption I nor assumption II is implicit.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
